verdict.rationale: Granola documents a RESTful API with scoped API keys, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt file is a docs index, not a machine-readable API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
